content2.content: Ensuring your Firebase integration works correctly is crucial. Firebase provides tools like the Local Emulator Suite and Test Lab.

content4.content: Run Firebase services locally to test your app without affecting production data or incurring costs.

content7.content: Upload your app to Test Lab to run it on devices hosted in a Google data center. This helps find bugs across different Android versions and device configurations.

content9.content: Use emulators for local development and Test Lab for pre-release validation.
